block-guide:
CORE/QUERY (Query Loop) A list of posts chosen by conditions, each drawn by the blocks you place in its post-template. For a plain "latest posts" list with no layout of its own, core/latest-posts is simpler. REQUIRED STRUCTURE core/query (WHICH posts) > core/post-template (HOW ONE post looks; repeated per result). Inside the template: post-title, post-date, post-excerpt, post-featured-image, post-terms, post-author… alone or in groups. Optional siblings of the template: core/query-pagination (with query-pagination-previous / -numbers / -next) and core/query-no-results (shown when nothing matches). Post blocks inside the template are comments only: the server renders them. THE QUERY ATTRIBUTE postType, perPage (null = the site's "posts per page"), order / orderBy, author, search, exclude, sticky, taxQuery, parents. inherit:true = take the posts of the current WordPress view: a category archive shows that category, a search shows its results (archive templates use this). On an ordinary page it shows that page itself, not posts. inherit:false = this block's own conditions, on any page. queryId names the block's pagination address (?query--page=2); give two lists on one page different ids. MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Nothing here yet.

Only core/query has HTML (
, plus its align class); post-template, pagination and no-results have none of their own. LAYOUT AND SPACING post-template layout: {"type":"default"} = a list; {"type":"grid","columnCount":3} = cards. core/query has no spacing settings: put it in a group to give it margin or padding. Excerpts come from the post's excerpt field, else from its text; set excerpt on posts whose body is made of server-rendered blocks, or the card stays empty. CHECK Open the page: the list shows real posts (drafts never appear) and, with more posts than perPage, the pagination links work.
